description: The VBA projects a workbook built from this repository can hold. Each configuration is one VBA project; modules from different configurations are never combined. tools/Sync-EXCEL_UI-VBA.ps1 imports a configuration, tools/compare_vba_export.py checks an export against one, and tools/check_vba_calls.py analyses each. Each configuration lists its modules in import order, and module_descriptions gives the description tools/render_docs.py writes into the module tables of the documentation.

module_descriptions.src/M_EXCEL_UI_RUNTIME.bas: Host operations, diagnostics, result buffers, and quiet-update scope
module_descriptions.src/M_EXCEL_UI_TITLEBAR.bas: WinAPI declarations, owned title-bar bits, and frame refresh
module_descriptions.src/M_EXCEL_UI_SNAPSHOT.bas: Snapshot state, capture/restore, and window identity
module_descriptions.demo/M_DEMO_CLEANUP_TESTS.bas: Excel harness for demo sheet reset and template cleanup

production.description: The production package of INSTALLATION.md: the four modules of src/.

development.description: A workbook that runs the regression suite and release certification: the production modules and the regression module.

demo.description: The demo workbook: the production modules, the two demo modules and the demo cleanup harness.
